CREATE VIEW v_pediatric_heart_candidates AS
WITH heart_avg_wait AS (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(c.wait_time FROM '^[0-9]+') AS numeric)) AS avg_heart_wait
    FROM clinical c
    JOIN transplant_matching tm ON 1=1
    WHERE tm.org_spec = 'Heart'
),
clinical_with_urgency AS (
    SELECT 
        cd.clin_recip_registry,
        cd.wait_time,
        cd.med_urgency,
        CASE 
            WHEN cd.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
            WHEN cd.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
            WHEN cd.med_urgency = '2' THEN 3
            WHEN cd.med_urgency = 'Status 2' THEN 3
            WHEN cd.med_urgency = '3' THEN 2
            WHEN cd.med_urgency = 'Status 3' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END AS urgency_score
    FROM clinical cd
)
SELECT 
    rd.recip_registry AS kid_id,
    rd.age_count AS age,
    cw.med_urgency AS urgency_level,
    ROUND(CAST((CAST(SUBSTRING(cw.wait_time FROM '^[0-9]+') AS numeric)) / NULLIF(haw.avg_heart_wait, 0) AS numeric), 2) AS wait_time_ratio
FROM recipients_demographics rd
JOIN clinical_with_urgency cw ON rd.recip_registry = cw.clin_recip_registry
JOIN transplant_matching tm ON rd.recip_registry = tm.recip_ref_reg
CROSS JOIN heart_avg_wait haw
WHERE rd.age_count < 18
AND tm.org_spec = 'Heart'
ORDER BY urgency_score DESC, wait_time_ratio DESC;
